mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during the period of FEDFUNDS decline, or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline over the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.8% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing the 4.8% threshold, or the rise is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to correlate significantly with the interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO (Pearson r < 0.3), or the interaction effect diminishes in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.5%, or the tightening cycle does not materialize as expected (FEDFUNDS stays below threshold).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 114.2334 (trendline) indicates robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during the period of INDPRO above trendline, or the trendline is not maintained.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 137,993 (trendline) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite PAYEMS crossing below trendline, or the decline is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: The co-movement between GDP demand (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 5-week moving averages signals a resilient demand cycle, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to correlate significantly with the interaction of GDPC1 and RSAFS (Pearson r < 0.3), or the interaction effect weakens in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4%), sustained job growth (PAYEMS) above 137,993 fosters investor optimism, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE staying below 4% and PAYEMS above trendline, or the combination does not occur as expected.
